The '''Ordan Spine Mountains''' were a fertile region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]] beyond the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]]. Between the towering [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] were valleys home to thriving farming villages and hermitages for religious orders, like the [[Paladins of the Adamite Tower]], located in the fortified remains of a crashed [[Starship/Legends|starship]] known as the [[Adamite Tower]].<ref name="NoP" />
